text: Yes, mostly already built: chat-wake.yml fires the routine of the account on duty ~40 s after your message. The gap: those chat wakes deliberately hold no repo lease, so they answer but can't ship. Written as TCL86: a chat wake will take the lease itself when it's free and build/ship what you ask. That changes the routine prompt, which a session can't edit for you; the next ENGINEER session will give you the exact text to paste.
